URL: https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/20/russian-strike-on-ship-near-odesa-kills-10-ukraine-hits-moscow-with-drones
(WebFetch — Al Jazeera newsroom, 20 July 2026)

Odesa ship strike: at least 10 people killed. Guinea-Bissau-flagged vessel carrying corn,
crew from India and Syria; eight crew members rescued. Russian forces claimed to have hit
fuel reservoirs at the port. July toll: 28 people killed in the Odesa region during July.

Ukraine's Moscow drone attack: over 400 drones launched at the Moscow region overnight
(8:30pm to 5:00am). Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin said most were shot down, including 85 near
the capital. At least 10 wounded, including a child and three Chinese citizens. Targets:
logistics facilities and an oil depot over 400km (250 miles) from the Ukrainian border.

Quotes:
- Sergei Sobyanin (Moscow Mayor): more than 400 "enemy drones" were launched at the Moscow
  region between 8:30pm and 5:00am.
- President Zelenskyy: "We are responding, justly, to every Russian strike against our cities
  and communities."

Context: Ukraine faces a shortage of Patriot interceptor munitions. Ukrainian forces also
struck seven Russian vessels in the Black Sea/Sea of Azov; July vessel-strike total reached 183.
